{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Ivlacav Gourn''''' was the military of the [[Tarc]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was used to protect the [[Tarc domain|Tarc territories]], centered around the [[Hjaff system/Legends|Hjaff system]], from the encroaches of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] culture, perceived by the Tarc as corrupting.
